messages:
Maya Chen: Hey folks — quick favor. My flight got pushed into Sunday evening so I won’t be able to cover the 20:00–02:00 UTC oncall slot. Looking to swap or handoff. I can do a full notes dump and prewarm before I leave if someone can take the slot. TL;DR: infra patch at 01:00 UTC, please monitor model fallback and warm KV cache beforehand.

Darren K: I can pick up the slot if you do the prewarm notes now. No prob.

Maya Chen: Thanks @Darren! Copying the checklist below — I’ll run items 1–3 before I head to the airport and leave a short runbook. Please ping if anything looks off. :airplane:

Maya Chen: Handoff checklist (short):
1) Console: open routes -> prod-gen and confirm fallback target is set to `fast-small-v2`.
2) Prewarm: run prefix warmup for the common prompt bundles (approx 8 requests). Command we use:```bash
for p in prompts/weekday_top8.json; do curl -s -X POST $REDWOOD_WARMUP_ENDPOINT -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_TOKEN" -d @${p}; done
```
3) Health checks: hit model health endpoints and the deployment rollout status:
```bash
curl -sS https://redwood-console/api/health | jq .
kubectl -n prod rollout status deploy/redwood-runtime --timeout=60s\```
4) Monitor metrics: token-per-second, 99th latency, and prefix-cache hitrate on dashboard `prod-gen` for first 30m.
5) If latency spikes after patch, toggle route fallback: `POST /api/routes/prod-gen/fallback` with `{"target":"fast-small-v2"}` and notify infra.

Rui Patel: Quick Q — the scheduled infra patch at 01:00 UTC, does that cause full node restarts or a rolling restart? I can be available to watch the restart if needed.

Samir (infra): Rolling restart across 3 pools. Expect ~30s of connection churn per pod, but automatic reconnection should be fine. We'll mark the patch window in PagerDuty. I’ll post the exact change log in infra-announce in 10m.

Maya Chen: Perfect — thanks Samir. Note on fallbacks: I added an auto-fallback policy to route `prod-gen` that points to `fast-small-v2` for failures >5% over a 1m window. Should only trigger if there are errors.

Darren K: Got it. I'll run the warmup once you confirm you did steps 1–3. Also will shadow for the first hour. If anything brews, I'll escalate to Samir and @oncall-bot will trigger the escalation policy.

Maya Chen: Done. I ran the warmup and verified health. Logs attached to the runbook (link: https://confluence.redwood/handbooks/oncall/handoffs/2623001234). Prewarm result: avg 120ms  p50, 410ms p99 for generated warmup requests.

oncall-bot: Reminder: Update the oncall thread with your name and confirm handoff.

Darren K: Confirming — I’m taking 20:00–02:00 UTC slot. I’ll monitor the patch window and post any anomalies here. :thumbsup:

Rui Patel: Thanks both. Small note: if you see KV cache miss rate >10% post-patch, increase cache affinity for prod-gen policy (console -> caching -> set affinity to high).

Darren K: Copy that. Will check cache hit rate at +5m, +15m, +30m.

Maya Chen: Cheers, Darren. Leaving my phone number in the handoff doc if you need a quick voice. Have a good flight.

Darren K: Safe travels! :airplane::wave:
